name: Glass rating card
oneLiner: an app-store style rating card pops in tilted on glass: the big rating counts up while five stars fill one by one with a glint, the number stamps, then a review quote and its reviewer slide in
say: when the speaker says how people rate it ('4.9 stars', 'people love it', 'here is what one user said'): the last star fills on the number, the quote lands as they read it
